artifact.name: Z-Girl Founding Professional Network Commercial Activation Funnel

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: Adds a governed no-cost founding-professional interest funnel, qualification journey, jurisdiction capture, professional-specific consent, and transparent separation between free interest submission and any future fee-based credential, membership, implementation, or provider service. Provider matching, referrals, booking, clinical services, clinical records, compensation/referral economics, paid credential activation, paid professional workspace access, and public network activation remain locked.

ai_uses.purpose: Commercial funnel completion, professional intake specialization, qualification journey design, privacy/safety copy, governance boundary enforcement, and release preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: AI accelerates a premium professional recruitment experience while keeping clinical authority, credential issuance, economics, and activation under human governance
ai_uses.human_oversight: Independent professional qualifications remain externally governed; Z-Girl only reviews program fit and competency; participant data is not requested in the interest flow; owner retains release, pricing, credential, and network activation authority
ai_uses.provenance: Application and governance implementation in lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach PR #54 on factory/professional-network-commercial-activation; extends the existing Professional Support specialization and Z-Girl v2.7-v2.9 credential architecture

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Clinical authority, professional licensure, safeguarding decisions, credential issuance, provider/referral economics, and public/paid activation must remain human-governed.

evidence: Founding-network page now presents a clear premium invitation, value proposition, qualification standard, and post-interest journey
Professional intake language is specialized rather than reusing generic product inquiry copy
AI supports funnel and workflow design without being positioned as a professional replacement
The experience preserves explicit human professional authority and qualification gates
The funnel recruits qualified human support around Z-Girl while avoiding clinical overclaiming
Applicants are instructed not to submit patient, student, client, participant, health, or safeguarding information
Verify Release passed on PR #54 before receipt refresh
Existing server-side lead validation, rate limiting, Resend/webhook delivery architecture, and safe fallback remain reused
The funnel remains text-first with semantic sections, explicit calls to action, and plain-language qualification steps
Professional role, population/setting, and jurisdiction fields make the intake applicable across multiple professional contexts
Z-Girl human-first doctrine and existing credential hierarchy remain intact
No parallel source of truth, registry, marketplace, or training platform is introduced
Free expression of interest is explicitly separated from future paid products and does not guarantee selection, credentialing, referrals, or paid opportunities
Provider matching, booking, clinical care, records, compensation/referral economics, paid credential activation, and network activation remain locked

exceptions: Professional credential naming, claims, pricing, and provider/referral economics require final owner and applicable legal/compliance review before paid or public activation.

Live provider discovery, referrals, virtual counseling connections, booking, clinical messaging, clinical records, provider compensation, paid credential issuance, paid membership, and professional workspace entitlements are not activated in this release candidate.
